core_obligations: Reduce to surjectivity at the last term by left exactness, and for a compatible family choose the preimage sets level by level (proof lines 21001-21008).

Use the Mittag-Leffler property of the kernel system and countability of the index set to correct the chosen elements so that they form a compatible family, giving the required preimage (proof lines 21008-21027).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to surjectivity and choose preimages level by level (proof lines 21000-21008).
Correct them into a compatible family using Mittag-Leffler and countability (proof lines 21008-21028).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a short exact sequence of countable inverse systems, if the kernel system is Mittag-Leffler then the sequence of limits is exact (statement lines 20986-20998). The proof does not apply a general exactness theorem: it reduces to surjectivity at the last term by left exactness, chooses preimages level by level, and then corrects them into a compatible family using the Mittag-Leffler property and countability of the index set (proof lines 21000-21028). The correction step that produces a compatible family is the substance of the argument. H2.
